synthetic_result.scope: Artificial 4x3x4 only; actual original class and one original iteration. No MST/clean/real data or 100-step claim.

limitations: Source review plus tiny artificial interface does not establish that real MST/100-step execution will complete.
Float32 preset readback tolerances are implementation tolerances, not scientific quality thresholds.
S82 raw cumulative attempts remain three (two pre-forward technical failures after load, one successful forward); S83 is a distinct one-optimizer attempt.
Known approximate P/K constrain this observer fit; no depth truth, generation benefit, strong-baseline convergence or novel method has been established.
